name: Django + Django Ninja + PostgreSQL + Celery
note: Each task runs a real command. Token figures are not recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files. Tests run against SQLite so no PostgreSQL or Redis service is required.

eval_tasks.title: Django settings and NinjaAPI boot cleanly
eval_tasks.instruction: The project must import, the NinjaAPI router tree must mount, and the health probe must reach the database.
assertions: Django system checks report no issues
the probe executes a real query against the database
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python manage.py check && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -k health -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Typed CRUD surface over the ORM
eval_tasks.instruction: Pydantic request and response schemas must round-trip through the Django ORM with migrations applied.
assertions: migrations apply against a fresh database
create, list, retrieve and delete all round-trip
responses match the declared response schema
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_api.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite covering the controls named in security/checks.json: tenant isolation, schema strictness, auth, and container hardening.
assertions: unauthenticated and invalid-token requests are rejected
a deactivated key stops working immediately
listing, direct id lookup, search and delete are all tenant-scoped
a foreign id returns 404 rather than 403, so membership does not leak
extra="forbid" blocks tenant_id smuggling in the payload
tenant_id is never present in a response body
Celery accepts JSON only, never pickle
Django security middleware is active and the Dockerfile is rootless
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/test_security.py -q -p no:warnings

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete functional and security suite must pass with no failures.
eval_tasks.verify: cd starter && python -m pytest tests/ -q -p no:warnings
